To take such a precious vegetable and put it to the fire is decadent in a way.|Inventory|TotK}} ==Location and Uses== ==={{BotW|-}}=== Roasted Big Radishes are a type of [[Roasted Food]], resulting from [[Big Hearty Radish]]es that have made contact with [[Fire]] or a [[Scorching Climate]].{{Cite Guide|BotW Piggyback|page= 295}} Some consider the making of Roasted Big Radishes to be indecent, as there are better ways to Cook such precious vegetables. [[Link]] can heal six [[Heart]]s by eating a Roasted Big Radish. ==={{TotK|-}}=== Roasted Big Radishes reappear in {{TotK}} and are again a variety of [[Roasted Food]]. They can be made by exposing [[Big Hearty Radish]]es to [[Fire]] or a [[Scorching Climate]]. Some consider the making of Roasted Big Radishes to be indecent, as there are better ways to Cook such precious vegetables.
